text:
omar: Heads-up: Eid falls on Thu of the global launch week and we have a company blackout for feature freezes. I'm based in AMER and have one floating holiday left. Can I apply that to take the day off? If not, what's the fallback so I don't lose the floating day at year-end?
people-ops: Thanks for flagging, @omar. Short version: religious observances are considered for reasonable accommodation. We can treat this as a floating-holiday swap or a protected accommodation request. Please submit either the Holiday Swap form or the Accommodation Request form (links below). If it's a protected accommodation, the blackout won't automatically block it.
people-ops: Links: https://hr.internal/redwood/forms/holiday-swap | https://hr.internal/redwood/forms/accommodation-request
maria: Omar, I want to support you. Operationally we need coverage for the launch day. If you put in the swap/accommodation, I'll propose a coverage plan (shift coverage or async handoff) so we can keep launch checks green.
benefits-bot: Reminder: Floating holidays expire 12/31 unless approved for carryover. Carryover policy: up to 2 floating days can be rolled with manager+people-ops approval, otherwise they expire. Contractors: no carryover or payout. FTEs: cash-out only at offboarding or exec-approved exception.
omar: If we mark it as an accommodation, does that preserve my floating day for use later?
legal: @omar: Practical note from Legal 51 the company treats religious accommodation requests under federal/state law; payroll/benefits can't penalize you for exercising that right. If you're approved for an accommodation instead of using a floating holiday, we'll record it as an approved unpaid/paid religious accommodation per policy and it won't count against your PTO balance.
people-ops: Implementation choices: 1) Use floating holiday (consumes your floating balance). 2) Submit accommodation (no PTO consumed; HR records protected leave). 3) Use PTO or unpaid time if you prefer. We recommend accommodation if you'd rather keep the floating day for other purposes.
payroll-bot: FYI: If recorded as an accommodation and our payroll systems show a paid day, payroll will process as regular pay based on your status. If unpaid accommodation is requested, payroll will follow that flag. Add a note on the form for payroll preference.
maria: I'll pre-approve coverage contingent on HR approval. Omar, add me to the form so I can sign off fast.
omar: Thanks all. One more Q: I'm in a region where we also have statutory Eid day off. How does that interact with floating holidays?
people-ops: Good question. If your local statutory holiday already gives you the day, that counts first. Floating holidays are for additional observances or swap-in days. If statutory holiday grants the day, you won't need to use floating/PTO. If dates differ, we can pro-rate or provide a floating day as appropriate.
people-ops: Next steps: Omar submits accommodation OR swap form + selects option. Manager (Maria) should be CC'd. People Ops will respond within 1 business day. If you need an immediate temporary note for the launch rota, reply here and we'll post the provisional approval.
omar: I'll submit accommodation now and CC @maria. Thanks for the quick answers.
people-ops: Noted 51 we'll aim to process as a blackout accommodation exception. Closing note: blackout exceptions for religious accommodation, jury, or serious medical needs are handled case-by-case and do not imply a general blackout override for vacation requests.
omar: Appreciate it :pray:
